messages:
Sam: Quick question — when the console shows an SLO threshold alert, should the notify routing policy shown be the effective runtime policy or always the tenant's preferred config? I'm leaning runtime-effective so it's honest, but worried about confusing customers.

Mira: runtime-effective seems right, otherwise users think they own the routing when fallback happened.

Lee: runtime-effective is fine, but we need to show a 'reason' badge: e.g., 'routed to backup tier due to capacity' so it's transparent.

Jon: +1 on reason badge. Also can we show the applied quota/window that triggered the route? Ops needs that for postmortems.

Mira: we currently store routing_decision in telemetry (proto: RoutingDecision) but UI doesn't fetch it — that's an API change.

Sam: are we comfortable extending the SLO alert API to return routing_decision? That will impact Dedicated/Private control planes.

Lee: API change is OK but must be opt-in via feature flag and paginated — not huge payload. Also update SDK.

Mira: sample response we'd return:

```
{
  "alert_id": "a-123",
  "slo_id": "s-77",
  "threshold": "p99>200ms",
  "routing_decision": {
    "policy": "per-tenant",
    "applied_tier": "backup",
    "reason": "capacity_spillover",
    "quota_window": "5m"
  }
}
```

Sam: ok. What about showing a 'quieting' state — we have quiet-windows and noise suppression heuristics. Should console show if an alert was suppressed vs delivered?

Jon: yes. Distinguish SUPPRESSED vs DELIVERED in the card. :loud_sound: for delivered.

Lee: UX note — we shouldn't show suppressed details to all users; maybe only to users with 'alert-audit' permission.

Mira: agreed. We'll add an 'exposure' field with enum {DELIVERED, SUPPRESSED, SAMPLE} and 'audit_log_url' optional.

Sam: last Q: per-tenant quota overrides — UI allows edit today, do we keep that or move to API-only?

Lee: keep UI but add guardrails: show cost impact estimate and require confirmation for overrides > 25%.

Jon: ops: also need a quick link to create support ticket from the alert card.

Mira: I'll sketch API proto and open a PR with the telemetry + UI changes, will post design doc in ~24h.

Sam: sweet. If Mira posts draft, I'll collect product feedback. Thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: created issue #3201 for API proto tracking (link: https://git.redwood/infr/3201)
